note: The four-view of the Tiger II with the Henschel turret, 2576 by 1358 px, a blueprint in white on blue turned to black on white: the front at the top left, the left side with the nose left at the top right, the rear under the front and the plan under the side with the nose left. It is the same drawing as the M1:35 sheet in shots/ref/ger_kt.jpg, which dimensions the hull at 7380 mm and the width over the tracks at 3755. The side and the plan are taken off the 7.38 m of hull, 1100 px in both; the front and the rear off the 3.755 m over the tracks. Pinned at the first road wheel on the ground in the side, at the nose in the plan, and at the middle of the tracks on the ground in the front and the rear.
